response.overview: Road to Shujaa follows six Kenyan athletes fighting to enter the world of triathlon, an elite endurance sport almost unheard of in their country. Through intimate character stories and cinematic glimpses of Kenya's landscapes, the film captures the grit, hope, and heart behind their journey. More than a sports narrative, Road to Shujaa reveals the rise of a new generation of Kenyan endurance athletes and celebrates the power of determination to defy the odds. What does it take to rise when the world expects you to stay in your lane?
response.title: Road to Shujaa
